title: CHANGELOG.md has no entries for 0.1.7 to 0.1.13: the generator matches note headings exactly, and every note since 0.1.7 suffixes its headings (eg '## Fixed -- reaches every estate')
body:
Found by the ST0010 pre-publication review (2026-10-24), verified by vc on main.

CHANGELOG.md gives each of 0.1.7 to 0.1.13 only "_No changelog sections in this release note._" (lib/release.notes:536). RELEASES/0.1.6.md has `## Fixed`, which the generator reads; RELEASES/0.1.7.md has `## Fixed -- reaches every estate` and `## Fixed -- devbin's own tree`, which it does not, and the later notes follow 0.1.7's shape. So seven releases have an empty changelog, and `release check` did not notice.

Fix in the core, as a default with an override, not per note: either the generator reads a heading that begins with a changelog section name, or `release check` refuses a note none of whose headings the changelog reads. Then regenerate CHANGELOG.md.

Done when: CHANGELOG.md carries 0.1.7 to 0.1.13; a note the changelog would render empty is caught before a cut; for the release before devbin's public push.

## Resolution

**0212 (2026-10-24, by dc on vc's brief and rulings):** The changelog reads a note heading whose first word is a section's name. `## Fixed -- reaches every estate` renders under `### Fixed` with `#### reaches every estate` over its entries, and every heading for a section goes under one `### <Section>`, in the note's order. CHANGELOG.md is regenerated and carries 0.1.7 to 0.1.13. A new provider verb, `notes_lint`, asked by the cut's pre-flight and by `release check`, refuses a `releases` note none of whose headings is a section's. The refusal names the note's headings. A release with nothing for a changelog says so with `changelog: none` in its note's header, and that line over a note that has a section is refused. The two new arms fail on main and pass on the fix. release, releasecore, releasestatus, releasecut, docs, the six tree scans and help pass under BSD and GNU. Commits `ae29e506` and `9ecf7619`.

The tree scans then caught three slips in the first build, fixed in 9ecf7619 and re-run green under BSD and GNU (release, helpers, contract, documentation). Landed squashed at 9aac2f1b by vc, on landing suite 20261024-0831 at the stack tip 6cc594fb (2442 of 2442 ok, 5 environmental skips, the errors seal empty), for the release before devbin's public push.
